summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of PontiScore. All 11 backend pytest tests pass; the complete quiz -> dashboard -> lead form -> ThankYou flow works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: send_lead_emails() gracefully returns False when RESEND_API_KEY is empty - as designed. When key is added later, ensure Resend account is verified for the sender domain (RESEND_FROM_EMAIL currently uses onboarding@resend.dev fallback).
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
Question.jsx: auto-advance uses a 260ms setTimeout; back-to-back rapid clicks on options could theoretically queue two setTimeouts. Not observed as an issue in practice.
seed_data_creation: Test diagnostics and TEST_ prefixed leads created via API during tests (not cleaned up, but harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 11 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover /api/, /api/questions, /api/diagnostic (success/invalid/missing), /api/diagnostic/{id} (200 and 404), /api/lead (success with email_sent=false since RESEND_API_KEY empty, and 404 for bad diagnostic), /api/leads. All pass. Frontend E2E verified: Landing (landing-start-button-desktop @1440x900) -> Question auto-advance (needs >=500ms between clicks in tests since animation transition is 280ms + 260ms setTimeout) -> Dashboard renders total_score/tier/pillars -> Lead form validation ('Introduza o seu nome' error) and submission navigates to /thankyou -> Home button returns to /.
